    SECRET_KEY: str = "media-secret-key-change-in-production"

    # --- Banco de Dados (SQLite para desenvolvimento) ---
    DATABASE_URL: str = "sqlite:///media.db"
    SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS: bool = False
